results.title: Indigenous Peoples and AI: Defending Rights, Shaping the Future of Technology | Cultural Survival
results.content: # Indigenous Peoples and AI: Defending Rights, Shaping the Future of Technology. Each year on August 9, the world comes together to observe the International Day of the World’s Indigenous Peoples, a day dedicated to honoring the resilience, wisdom, and sovereignty of over 476 million Indigenous people worldwide. It serves as a solemn reminder of the ongoing struggles that Indigenous communities face to protect and safeguard their lands, cultures, and identities in a world increasingly shaped by colonial legacies and modern challenges. As technology continues to evolve, it is critical that Indigenous Peoples are not left behind in the digital age, especially in areas such as AI development, where the potential for both empowerment and exploitation exists. Without the active participation of Indigenous communities in AI development and governance, these systems are at risk of perpetuating historical patterns of cultural erasure and data exploitation.
